title: Entity Solr Document
description: Schema for Solr entity documents containing frequency and identifier fields (Impresso Project).

sqlid_s.description: SQL-compatible identifier for the entity. Same as 'id'. Composed of run-id alias, entity-id, and master label

l_s.description: Human-readable entity label: the master label with underscores replaced by spaces (e.g. 'ATS SDA' for the agency master label 'ATS_SDA').

p_s.description: Composite identifier combining entity id and label. Composite path (original_id|type)

mention_fq_f.description: Mention frequency for the entity over the whole corpus.
